metadata.description: Rebuilt directly from the CSV's set_number column as ground truth: one JSON entry per CSV set_number (index = set_number - 1), each with its true 4 CSV rows as section_1..section_4. path/height/width/annotation/sliceNumber looked up by (bid, secID) from prior merged JSON snapshots; left as empty string when no match was found. bid/secID/stain/globalID/z_mm/x_mm/dist_from_anchor come directly from the CSV.
